comment: The quest as a graph. `start` names the first stage. Each stage carries the objective the tracker shows, the dialogue state every NPC switches to on entering it (a key into each npc's `dialogue` in npcs.json), the transitions that leave it, and optionally `enter` actions run on arrival. A transition fires `on` an event — `talked:<npcId>` when that npc's dialogue is stepped through to its end (an id in npcs.json's `cast`, which is the only list of people there is from Phase 6), `riddle:solved` when the riddle overlay accepts an answer, `lock:<id>` when the player presses E at a word-locked door — and may `do` actions, move `to` another stage, or both. Actions are the names src/quest-manager.js implements (QuestManager.actions); an `after` is a delay in ms. `tokens` are substituted into dialogue lines before they are shown. test/quest.mjs checks all of this against npcs.json, riddle.json and index.html.

seek-keystone.objective: The muniment room is shut with a word. Find its door in the King's Tower.
seek-keystone.comment: Phase 4 moved openRiddle off `talked:scholar` and onto the word-lock itself. The Keystone the next two stages talk about is the riddle quest's own fiction and Phase 7 deletes all three stages with it; what changed here is the trigger and what opens.

present-keystone.objective: The word holds and the muniment room is open. You hold the Keystone — go and tell the Constable.
present-keystone.comment: openGate is on `enter` and not on the transition so that a save resumed here finds the door open again, the same way the terminal stage below does. Phase 6 repointed this at the Constable and put every stage in `default`: the Guard the player used to tell is gone with the other two of v1, and none of the twelve has a `hasKeystone` line — writing twelve of them for a quest Phase 7 deletes would be content with a known expiry date. The Keystone these two stages talk about is the riddle quest's own fiction and goes with them.

gate-open.objective: The muniment room stands open. Walk free — or stay and chat.
gate-open.comment: openGate again, because a save resumed at a terminal stage re-runs these.

frame.comment: The v2 frame (WISHLIST.md, Phase 1): the graph the mystery runs in. Not yet what the page plays; the riddle quest above is, until Phase 7 promotes this to the top level. Validated by validateQuest with the manager's grown action list, driven in Node by test/mystery.mjs, and every stage's dialogueState is checked against the twelve in npcs.json's `cast`. Events: talked:<npc>, bell:<n> (the nth ring), clue:<id>, press:<npc>:<clue>, ask:accuse, ask:journal, accused:<who>, verdict:<class>.

arrive.objective: The master mason is dead at the foot of the Chapel Tower stair. Find the Constable.

investigate.objective: Learn what happened to Hywel ap Gruffudd before Vespers.

accusing.objective: Name the one who killed him, or call it a fall.

full.objective: The Clerk hangs, the Steward is taken, and the lead is found in the town.

right.objective: The Clerk hangs. The Steward keeps his post.

wrong.objective: Someone hangs. Not the one who did it.

fall.objective: A fall. The inspector signs the sheet.
